Dear Candidates,




We are Hiring GEN AI Engineer/ AI Engineer For PAN India Locations, Below are the details




Job description

Role: AI Engineer / AIML Data Science and Gen AI


Experience : 6 to 9 Years


Location : PAN India


Notice Period : Immediate to 90 days


Mode of Interview : Virtual


Mandatory skills: AI Engineer Python, Langchain, LangGraph, Agentic AI, API, LLMs


Role & responsibilities
• Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI systems using Python
• Build autonomous AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, and tool usage
• Develop and manage multi-agent workflows and orchestration pipelines
• Integrate LLMs with APIs, databases, and enterprise applications
• Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
• Develop scalable backend services and microservices for AI applications
